cumulative_reports.hypothesis: no independence assumed within a walk; only the workers' coins are independent by construction
cumulative_reports.inequality: P(R > slack * E[R]) <= 1/slack   (per-walk Markov, mean only)
cumulative_reports.note: the v16 Chernoff row is WITHDRAWN: exp(-mean/3) needs independence that repeated class-keyed DP tests do not supply.
cumulative_reports.stopping_rule: the walk STOPS when cumulative reports reach the charged cumulative bound or S steps are done, whichever is first: the ceiling is enforced, not merely resident.

label_increment_raw.note: a repeat whose label increment is (0,0) carries NO solve equation (the denominator b-b0 vanishes): that, and only that, is a trap. A repeat with nonzero increment is a SOLVABLE self-collision (two label paths to one element), i.e. a success, not a loss.
